1 Scientific Literature.Title: Steel Slag as a Precursor Material for Alkali-Activated Binders: A Systematic Review
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: José C. Borba Jr., Guilherme J. Brigolini, Victor A. A. Oliveira, João L. Calmon, Eduardo F. Mariano
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Systematic bibliographic review (ProKnow-C) of steel slag as precursor in alkali-activated binders: bibliometrics, characterization methods, BOF properties and knowledge gaps.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Portfolio of 71 texts (2011-2021); China most publications, Construction and Building Materials top journal. BOF most used slag (61%), then EAF (18%); 47.7% of works blend with other precursors (fly ash 52%, BFS 38%). NaOH and Na2SiO3 most common activators; 86% use two-part method. Highest strength 75 MPa at 28 d (BOF with potassium citrate). Gaps: Rietveld, mechanical tests beyond compression/bending, durability, fresh state, one-part mixes.
